Messages.Author: Andy Brown
Messages.Body:


It certainly is. Someone borrowed my deck of me on Tues Night. They
had a weenie toreador with 2 Aching Beauties. I'm on two pool.

Tor: I bleed you using Enchant Kindered for 2
ME: Block, lose two pool, get ousted. Don't block and can't reduce
or deflect, get ousted. Decision. Block, they don't get edge, and it
becomes uncontrolled.

Nice to see my deck do well, nicer to see it do well in my hands.
Never mind!

Once this happened as the first four turns in a tournament I played:

Turn one, influence 4 to anson.
Turn two, get Anson active
Turn three, put two aching beauties on Anson, Enchant Kindred Victoria
Ash, influence in Victoria Ash.
Turn four, put two Aching Beauties on Victoria Ash, Bleed (with Aire
of Elation and change of target in my hand) get blocked, change of
target,
Start Voting (with Scorn of Adonis sitting in my hand) Kine resources
contested

Well, you get the drill... unfortunatly, no VP, since my prey had a
little bit to though AntiMalk Bleed deck that wiped the table (3 times
in the tournie).
